ProposeDecisionRequest.description:
Field requirement is action-dependent (docs/03 review_decisions.action):
group_id for 'accept_group'/'reject'; members_a/members_b for
'manual_match'; cash_record_ids for 'exclude'. Unused fields for a given
action are simply ignored, not rejected -- validated server-side by
application.commands.review.propose_decision, not by this schema.
